captions.detailed: This 3D model features a magnifying work lamp with a heavy, rounded rectangular black base and a vertical support block. A multi-segment gray metal arm extends from the base, utilizing revolute joints at the shoulder and elbow to adjust its reach. The arm terminates in a circular light ring and magnifying lens fixture, which is mounted on a pivoting tilt joint for precise angling.
captions.instruction: Generate a magnifying work lamp with a heavy black rectangular base, a two-segment gray arm connected via revolute joints, and a circular magnifying lens lamp head that can tilt at the tip of the arm.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part assembly. It starts with a base part consisting of a rounded box and a vertical block. The lower arm segment is modeled as a box with cylindrical joint ends. The upper arm segment is similarly constructed with boxes and cylinders for its elbow and wrist hinges. The lamp head is built by subtracting a cylinder from a larger disk to form the ring shade, then adding a thin glass cylinder for the lens, all connected via revolute joints defined with custom origins and rotation axes.
